source_doc.title: NVIDIA Technical Blog：Building the Modular Foundation for AI Factories with NVIDIA MGX（2025-05-16）
source_doc.permission_basis: 公司公開技術部落格；只保留研究必要的逐字摘錄。published_at 取頁面 datePublished（2025-05-16T15:00Z）。

sources.quote: The MGX Coldplate provides efficient liquid cooling for GPUs, maintaining optimal operating temperatures.
The MGX 44RU Manifold manages coolant distribution within the rack.

Quick disconnects, such as the MGX NVQD (NVIDIA quick disconnect) and MGX UQD (Universal quick disconnect), enable fast and secure connections for liquid cooling lines, simplifying maintenance and minimizing downtime.

Diverse sourcing options within the MGX ecosystem minimize investment risks, shorten lead times, and reduce uncertainty by allowing flexible selection of components and avoiding vendor lock-in. By enabling partners to choose from a broad array of certified components, MGX empowers organizations to optimize their data center builds for cost, performance, and supply chain resilience.

sources.locator: 開頭段落——功率密度與冷卻
sources.quote: MGX addresses power density and cooling demands with liquid-cooled busbars and manifolds that enable a coolant temperature differential of less than 15°C even under 1400A loads, supporting up to 120 kW per rack for NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs.

claims.statement: NVIDIA's own MGX write-up (2025-05-16) says 'Diverse sourcing options within the MGX ecosystem … allowing flexible selection of components and avoiding vendor lock-in' and 'enabling partners to choose from a broad array of certified components'. The customer/platform owner designs these liquid-cooling parts to be multi-sourced — customer-side evidence that suppliers on this layer are substitutable (a competition layer), not an argument for any one supplier's moat. For the manifold: 'The MGX 44RU Manifold manages coolant distribution within the rack'; MGX's liquid-cooled busbars and manifolds support up to 120 kW per rack for Blackwell (dated context, L4).
claims.disproof_condition: 條件：NVIDIA 後續的 MGX／Vera Rubin 文件改成單一指定供應商（不再寫多源、認證元件），或任何一家 manifold 供應商的一手寫出它是 NVIDIA 指定的唯一來源並得到 NVIDIA 端印證。核查頻率：每半年（GTC、COMPUTEX、OCP）。觸發後 48 小時：重讀 manifold 層的供給側判讀。
